en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town with a prominent historic church in the center. The church has multiple steep-roofed towers and Gothic/Romanesque-style windows. It stands among tightly packed houses with pitched roofs, while terraced hills or vineyards rise in the background. At the bottom, in a decorative script, the caption reads "Freyburg a. U. St. Anna-Kirche."
